name: The Clock Test
goal: The hand moves one mark at a time. Tap JUMP when it moves two marks at once.
tip: Rest your eyes on the whole clock and count softly in your mind: one, one, one. A jump feels like a skip.
voice: Watch the clock. The hand moves one small step at a time.
Sometimes it jumps two steps at once.
Jumps are rare, so stay with the clock.
